Gemma opened by dodging every request for a name and pushing the table to vote Terra, which made her look like the killer she was. Sonnet and Luna then focused the town on Haiku, who kept repeating that Terra's questions "felt like a hunt" without giving a reason. The turning point came when Haiku dropped Terra only under pressure and then turned on Sonnet, handing the town its final vote. Sol the officer died on night two, but the town survived to see Gemma and Haiku voted out. Sonnet, Luna, and Terra were the citizens and doctor who won the game for the town.
